title: Amazon DynamoDB to Amazon Kinesis
description: Stream DynamoDB table changes to Kinesis

introBox.headline: How it works
text: When new items are added to the DynamoDB table, the item-level changes in the table will be streamed to the Kinesis Data Stream.

bullets.text: Building serverless applications with streaming data: Part 1
Test using the Amazon Kinesis data generator

testing.headline: Testing
text: 1. After deployment, add an item to the DynamoDB table.
2. Go to CloudWatch Metrics for the deployed Kinesis Data Stream. You will see incoming record metrics for the item data.

cleanup.headline: Cleanup
text: 2. Confirm the stack has been deleted: aws cloudformation list-stacks --query "StackSummaries[?contains(StackName,'STACK_NAME')].StackStatus"

authors.name: James Beswick
authors.bio: James is a senior developer advocate for Serverless Applications at Amazon Web Services based in the US. Prior to joining AWS Ben worked in a number of different technical roles specializing in workflow Automation and web development.
